label: prop:mass-tower-coefficient-stratification
title: Mass-tower coefficients $(\lambda_V, \lambda_S, \lambda_{\mathrm{pair}}, \alpha_k)$ as Wedderburn-block projections
html:
Working over A = H_n(R, q), every prefactor \alpha_k in the unified mass formula

  \mathfrak{m}_{q, \mathcal{K}}(\mathcal{T}) = \sum_{k = 0}^{n-1} \alpha_k \cdot \mathfrak{m}^{(k)}_{q, \mathcal{K}}(\mathcal{T})

is the Plancherel-weighted projection onto a specific curvature-rank stratum \Lambda_k. No prefactor is a free fit. Each is the unique scalar making the depth-k stratum reproduce its Bethe--Weizsäcker counterpart.

Coefficient-to-stratum mapping.

See Table 1.

Each row reads: the Bethe--Weizsäcker coefficient is the Plancherel-weighted Frobenius integral over partitions \lambda in the indicated stratum \Lambda_k. The sum \sum_{\lambda \in \Lambda_k} w_\lambda(1) \leq 1. Thus each coefficient is automatically bounded. We require neither truncation nor fitting.
